chapters.title: When and where the event takes place
chapters.body_html:
Date

The event runs on 20–23 Aug 2026 (Thursday to Sunday). Thursday is arrival and registration day, Friday is the accompanying programme (fair, arenas, registration), Saturday is the main battle, Sunday is clean-up and departure.

Location

A meadow between the town of Křtiny and the village of Bukovina (South Moravia).

  • GPS: 49.29895232776445, 16.759155153131733
  • Map: open in Google Maps

Detailed travel instructions (car, bus, on foot) are in the How to get to us section.

Registration

  • Registration runs through the external Registračka.cz system.
  • You need to create an account, fill in your personal data and sign up for a particular event. The data is filled in only the first time.
  • The exact link for the 2026 edition will be published by 15 May 2026.
  • Registration runs in waves. Once one army fills up, the limits are raised further.
  • Details on the Registration page.
The date and location are fixed per CLAUDE.md (source of truth). Some programme details are still being clarified — keep an eye on this page and registered participants will receive an e-mail.

chapters.title: Who the event is for and what to bring (documents)
chapters.body_html:
Age limits

  • The event is intended for playing participants over 12 years. For younger children there is a separate children's game.
  • Participants under 18 must hand in a completed and signed Application for players under 18 at registration.
  • Persons under 15 may take part only in the company of a person over 18 who is responsible for them (parent/legal guardian). Without a signed permit we will not let them in.
  • Children under 12 are at all times the responsibility of their parents.

Required documents

Each player must have:

  • health insurance card,
  • ID card.
  • The player may be asked to present them at registration.
  • Participants from abroad (incl. Slovakia) present proof of health insurance.
  • If you arrive by car, print and fill in the Parking card and place it behind the windscreen (see How to get to us).
Without a printed, properly filled-in and legally signed application participants under 18 will not be allowed into the battle. The current PDF of the application will be added once the 2026 registration system is finalised.

Quick „what to bring" checklist

Player
  • costume
  • weapon / weapons (better more — see Weapons)
  • gloves (protect fingers)
  • canteen or container for water
  • insurance card + ID
  • own medication
  • snack, your own drink
  • suitable neutral footwear (no yellow-and-white sneakers)
  • own mug and bowl (plastic will be charged)
  • camping gear (tent, sleeping bag, …)
Under 18 + driver
  • signed application from the legal guardian
  • insurance card
  • medication + instructions for the medic
  • Under 15: an 18+ companion
  • — for drivers —
  • parking card behind the windscreen
  • patience on the dusty road
  • respect for the organisers' instructions

chapters.title: Event programme — schedule
chapters.body_html:
The main framework of the 2026 edition (exact times will be specified in the week before the event):

Day What's happening
Thu 20 AugArrival of participants and event registration. After dusk a large fire and a guitar session.
Fri 21 AugAccompanying programme: Spread Blanket (bazaar/flea market), vendor fair, arenas (1v1, 5v5, „Randomiser", archery), registration and weapon approvals continue. In the evening campfires, music, fun. Lights out 23:30.
Sat 22 AugMain battle. Wake-up 8:00, roll-call and rules explanation + breakfast without costumes 8:30. Registration, weapon approval and dressing 9:00–10:30. Calling-out of armies 10:30, ruler's fifteen-minute moment of glory 10:45–11:00. Main battle 11:00 to about 16:00–17:00, lunch break between 13:00–14:00.
Sun 23 AugCamp clean-up, packing, departure. In the afternoon an after-party with the organisers — whoever stays helps and chats.

Friday programme in more detail

  • Spread Blanket — all-day bazaar / flea market with gear. Under a shelter next to registration.
  • Fair — vendors of thematic gear (see Stalls and vendors).
  • Arenas — start at about 15:00 depending on the number of participants: 1v1 combat arena, 5v5, „Randomiser", 1v1 archery arena. Sign up at registration.
  • People, campfires, music — fires 50 m from the forest (marked) and after the organiser's approval. Spade/shovel available at the org tent.
The exact times of Friday's registration (from when to when) will be added about two weeks before the event. Saturday's times are fixed.

chapters.title: Camping and conduct in the camp
chapters.body_html:
The camping rules (fire, smoking, alcohol, night quiet, litter) are described in detail in Rules → Participation in the event and conduct in the camp. Here is a quick summary:

  • What the organiser says, goes. The organiser's word cannot be circumvented.
  • Costume requirement applies the whole event — even outside the battle, even for companions.
  • Friday after 22:00 night quiet in the camp and surroundings.
  • Fire only in approved fire pits. Your own fire pit only with the organiser's approval. Portable fire pits and grills OK if they don't damage the lawn.
  • Wood only from brought-in supplies or by collecting fallen wood. No felling.
  • Smoking is forbidden in the entire game area. In the camp by the fire OK if no one minds.
  • Alcohol/intoxicating substances: anyone under the influence will not be allowed into the battle. Strict ban during the battle.
  • After the event flattened grass on the meadow. No holes from stakes, no unburied fire pits, no scattered litter.
  • No means no. Respect for the personal limits of every participant. A trusted person will be present at the event.

What will be provided on site

Will be
  • portable toilets (toi-toi)
  • drinking water in a tank
  • pub (see Food and drink)
  • firewood
  • medic for the whole time
Not guaranteed
  • mobile phone signal
  • electrical sockets
  • bathing water source

chapters.title: Pub, food and drink
chapters.body_html:
The organisers do not provide complete catering. Everyone takes care of their meals as they can. To make it easier, on site there will be:

  • a tank with drinking water,
  • an arranged pub,
  • a sweet breakfast before the roll-call,
  • a snack during Saturday's battle.

U Zeleného draka

The pub is provided for you by the U Zeleného draka crew: Ondřej Teplý (Flejm), Tobiáš Tyc (Mýval), Matouš Frič (Střevo).

The pub area will be expanded to 3 large tents forming an enclosed space. There will also be a central campsite and other facilities.

What to bring

  • Your own mug and bowl. Plastic dishes will be charged so the meadow isn't littered with cups.
  • Your own snack.
  • Your own drink if you want something other than water (e.g. cold green tea).

chapters.title: How to get to us (car, bus, on foot)
chapters.body_html:
Venue: a meadow between the town of Křtiny and the village of Bukovina (South Moravia).

GPS coordinates
49.29895232776445, 16.759155153131733
Open in Google Maps

By car — via Bukovina (recommended)

From Brno head towards Ochoz u Brna. Continue to the village of Březina, where you stick to the main road (do not turn off to Křtiny). You drive through the whole village, then come serpentines and you arrive at a T-shaped intersection. Turn right towards Bukovina.

In Bukovina you reach a square with a bus stop. Beyond it there's a turn to the left — take that one. The road leads behind the houses, behind the last house it turns left and continues as a paved road into the fields. You pass an agricultural cooperative (on the left) and silage pits (on the right). Continue further on.

When you come across the nearest turn to the right, you're there. You drive directly at the intersection onto the meadow and park in the parking area.

By car — via Křtiny (alternative, harder)

The route via Křtiny is a bit harder on the car. In Křtiny orient yourself by the church in the middle of the town. Stand so that you have the church behind you (on the left the municipal office, on the right the U Farlíků Inn — direction Brno). The very first turn to the left leads straight uphill — that one.

The hill is long and quite steep, we recommend a reasonable run-up. Continue straight, do not turn off anywhere (even if another road looks better). On the right you pass garages, on the left cottages. In some places watch out for the chassis.

After a while you reach the edge of the meadow. Don't turn onto the meadow right away, drive further along the forest on the same road. At a T-shaped intersection where the road turns left into a tree-lined alley, you're there. Turn onto the meadow right here and park.

  • Print and place behind the windscreen the Parking card (PDF will be added).
  • On the dusty road max. 15–20 km/h, preferably less.
  • Park exactly according to the organisers' instructions on the meadow near the camp (about 5 minutes' walk).

By bus

Key bus stops: Křtiny, municipal office · Bukovina · Bukovina, junction.

Arrival in Křtiny

A simpler option with minimal transfers, but with a stop before a hill that will test your fitness. Get off at any stop, stand so that you have the church behind you. In front of you the main road towards Brno and just a little bit a turn to the left climbing steeply upwards. That one.

You'll keep going up the hill until you get to the large meadow where we camp. The destination is at the T-shaped intersection. The path is marked by arrows on trees.

Arrival in Bukovina

From Brno more complicated — you change. You get off at the Bukovina, junction stop, cross the road and wait for the bus to Bukovina (one stop).

In Bukovina, after getting off, walk back a little in the direction you came from, to a small square with an old bus turning loop. There to the right along the paved road between the houses. Continue along it until it bends to the left up a small slope, then further until it changes into a field path. You pass the agricultural cooperative and silage pits, then straight to the T-junction. Destination.

On foot from the Junction (more adventurous)

For those who don't fear walking off the marked trail — an unmarked path directly from the Bukovina, junction bus stop.

You head on foot towards Bukovina, but not too far. You walk past a small forest by the road on the left side. At its further end (closer to Bukovina) a path turns into the forest — S. K. Neumann's Path, Cyril and Methodius Trail. A more detailed description would spoil the adventure. Red is now your colour.

By air

We're sorry. We didn't manage to convince air traffic control that nazgûl mounts can be considered civilian aircraft. So you can't get to us by air.

chapters.title: For parents
chapters.body_html:
If your offspring has convinced you that they want to attend the Pán Prstenů — Battle for Middle-earth LARP, you don't need to worry. The battle is being prepared by people experienced with similar events under the auspices of the Moravian LARP, z. s. association.

Safety

  • Emphasis on safety during registration, costume and weapon approval and during the battle itself.
  • In combat non-metal (mostly wooden) replicas of medieval weapons with a padded surface (foam, foam mat) are used. Details in Rules → Weapons.
  • Apart from minor scrapes and bruises, we usually don't have more serious injuries from similar events.
  • For the whole time a qualified medic with equipment for immediate treatment is present on site.

What a participant under 18 must have

  • your signed Application for players under 18,
  • insurance card,
  • a supply of liquids (there's water on the battlefield, but cold green tea refreshes better),
  • a snack to refill energy (muesli bars and the like).

Medication and health restrictions

If your offspring can't go without medication (asthma, allergies), make sure they really have it with them. Report this fact at registration to the medic, who will be near the registration desk.

Accompanying a child

If you plan to accompany your offspring, you can watch their efforts in the battle without worry — from a reasonable distance, so that some heroic warrior doesn't mistake you for an opponent.

If you wear natural and non-disturbing colours, or at least a hint of a costume (a simple tunic or cloak), you'll help eliminate 21st-century elements that disrupt the atmosphere.

For participants under 15 the legal guardian's accompaniment is mandatory.

Weather

The battle takes place in any weather. An overcast sky is no reason not to come.

Contact

  • E-mail: info@panprstenu.cz
  • E-mail: mealtiner@moravianlarp.cz
  • Phone: 606 369 997 (Mealtiner)

chapters.title: Photo, video and media
chapters.body_html:
We understand that you'd like to take nice photos or videos from the event. We have a few basic rules.

  • The game and players always come first. If you need a better shot, you must not get in the way or bother the players.
  • Equipment is at your own risk. The organisers don't guarantee against its damage or loss.
  • The costume requirement applies to photographers and camera operators too.
  • Safety during the game: the game is dynamic and moves quickly. If you find yourself between the fighters, press against the nearest tree, protect the equipment with your body and wait for the game to move on.
  • Consents and commercial use: participants gave consent for photos to be taken for the organisers. For your own commercial use, get permission from all the captured persons.
  • On the contrary, we'll be glad if after the event you provide us the photos for promotion of the event.
Drones can be used only after prior agreement with the organisers and only at moments selected by them, in compliance with the currently valid legislation.

Official photographers

We have official photographers arranged at the event. You don't have to fear that there won't be photos. If you don't have to take photos, come enjoy the event directly, not just through the viewfinder.

For journalists

If you're a journalist and want to write about the event, get in touch in advance at info@panprstenu.cz for accreditation.

chapters.title: Stalls and vendors (fair)
chapters.body_html:
On site we allow the participation of vendors of thematic gear (costumes, fabrics, weapons, leather goods, tablet-woven bands, armours and others). The stalls will be located next to the small square.

For participants

  • The organisers don't ensure or guarantee that on site you'll find everything and everyone.
  • If you need a specific thing from a specific seller, arrange directly with them in advance.

For vendors

  • Contact us in advance at info@panprstenu.cz.
  • Fill in a short form (the link will arrive as a reply to the e-mail).
  • Register for the event as a non-playing participant and pay the registration fee.
  • From the organisers you can expect a place for a stall and basic facilities. Everything else is on you.
Regulars (list to be updated for 2026)
  • Linea obchod — natural fabrics (linen, cotton, wool, silk, hemp), home textiles, leather.
  • ZZ Armoury — swords, sabres, arrows, shields, belts, bag-belts, bracers, quivers.
  • Baldonovo brašnářství — leather accessories, belts, bags, sheaths and pouches.
  • Sněděná Karkulka — handwoven tablet-woven goods (straps, belts).
  • Luboš Vostek — furs, bracers, bronze/brass kettles, tin tableware, blankets, wooden chests.
  • Saracénovo veteštnictví — jewellery from wood, bone and antler.
  • František Šín — minerals and jewellery from them.
  • Lesklý věcičky — handmade tinned jewellery and accessories with minerals.

chapters.title: I want to help with the preparation
chapters.body_html:
We'll be glad if you spend the whole week with us, or help with at least part of the event.

What helpers get

  • lots of fun,
  • food and drink provided,
  • an exemption from the costume requirement during work tasks,
  • the gratitude of the whole organising crew.

When help is needed

  • Event preparation — Monday 17 Aug – Wednesday 19 Aug 2026 (building facilities, preparing the game area, transporting equipment).
  • During the event — registration, approval, pub, logistics, coordination of the children's game.
  • Sunday clean-up — Sunday 23 Aug 2026 afternoon (packing up, cleaning the meadow, transporting equipment, after-party).

How to sign up

Write to info@panprstenu.cz with the subject „I want to help" and in a short message write when you have time and what you enjoy doing.
